clips.title: The story
paras: Thistlefur furbolgs attack outsiders from their village north of Astranaar. The tribe has fallen to corruption and now threatens travelers who approach its dens.

North of Astranaar, Thistlefur Village lies among Ashenvale’s woodland communities. Corruption has taken hold of the Thistlefur tribe, leaving its furbolgs maddened and hostile. They guard the paths through their settlement and attack travelers who draw near. Two fierce chieftains, Dal Bloodclaw and Rorgish Jowl, lead the clan. Their aggression threatens those on the roads and in nearby settlements.
